units.function: Host-side bridge that extracts structured Secret references from plugin config and resolves company/plugin-bound references through the central Secret service into plaintext for a plugin worker.
units.dependencyDirection: Depends on Paperclip Secret binding schema/service, JSON-Schema path utilities, database bindings and plugin/worker caller context. Plugin Host API handlers call it.
units.keyDataModels: EnvSecretRefBinding, company Secret binding for targetType plugin, version selector, configPath/projection metadata and Secret access context.
units.lifecycle: Discovers references in config, validates a resolve request, applies a process-local quota, finds an exact company/plugin/Secret/version binding and returns plaintext while asking SecretService to record access evidence.
units.testAssessment: Four pure tests passed for structured refs and pre-database company guards; two embedded-PostgreSQL tests for successful bound resolution/audit and cross-company denial were skipped locally. Missing cases include capability/status/config-currentness, actor forgery, version/rotation/revocation races, provider/audit failure, remote vaults, quotas, recursive config limits and plaintext leakage.
units.designRationale: Avoid putting raw credentials in plugin config and reuse the company vault while requiring explicit company and target binding.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs Secret use bound to an authenticated principal, exact Responsibility/DataAuthorization contract, Connector installation, purpose/destination and short-lived execution-node projection without exposing durable plaintext to the control plane or shared worker.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE structured opaque Secret refs, target/config-path binding, version selectors and value-free access events. Reimplement with host-owned actor/run/contract context, database-enforced exact binding, distributed quotas, denial audits, bounded schema traversal and destination-specific short-lived credential projection.
units.responsibilityConflict: The handler does not check plugin capability/status/current config, accepts caller-supplied actor/run evidence, has bypassable in-memory quotas and returns plaintext to a long-lived shared worker. It has no purpose/data-egress approval, and invalid objects can leak through error serialization.

units.function: Focused pure and embedded-database tests for plugin Secret ref parsing, company requirement, target binding, shared-vault resolution and access events.
units.dependencyDirection: Exercises production handler/SecretService/schema with mock preflight guards and optional embedded PostgreSQL.
units.keyDataModels: Company, plugin, Secret/version/binding/provider config and SecretAccessEvent.
units.lifecycle: Seeds plugins/companies/Secrets, synchronizes bindings, resolves or rejects and inspects access events.
units.testAssessment: The narrow cases are well targeted, but only 4 pure tests ran locally and 2 database cases skipped. The successful fixture has no declared Secret capability and denials intentionally leave no audit, highlighting missing governance assertions.
units.designRationale: Protect the transition from legacy UUID-like refs to structured company-bound Secret references.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS requires adversarial Secret compatibility tests across identity, responsibility, data purpose, Connector destination, rotation and no-leak failure paths.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the pre-database fail-closed guards, cross-company fixture and value-free event assertions; add authenticated-context injection, capability/status/config binding, distributed rate, rotation concurrency, remote provider, failure/outbox and plaintext absence tests.
units.responsibilityConflict: No accountable human, approval, data/export contract or exact work context is required or tested; caller-supplied evidence is not challenged.
